Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed that "The Bacchanal of the Andrians" was attributed to Nicolas Poussin at the very beginning, without verifying the attribution first. This assumption led to a cascading set of WebSurfer queries focused on confirming Poussin's authorship, even though early search results indicated that the painting is more commonly attributed to Titian and housed in the Museo Nacional del Prado. The Planner failed to pivot the investigation based on this conflicting information, leading to a misdirected search effort and ultimately an incorrect understanding of the painting's attribution and associated details. This foundational error affected the entire investigation, as the focus remained on Poussin and Rome, rather than Titian and Venice.
